recommended_option: Pool siP1_1, siP2_1, and siP2_4 as the combined Knockdown Arm versus the three NSC controls.
alternative_options: Reagent-specific primary effects; reagent fixed effect; no primary condition model.
scientific_rationale: The manifest defines siP as a group and the balanced 3-versus-3 design supports a perturbation-class effect, while exact reagents are unreplicated.
inferential_consequence: Estimates an average knockdown-arm effect under exchangeability; it does not establish equal reagent effects.
reviewer_risk_consequence: Off-target or reagent heterogeneity may challenge exchangeability; omission checks are mandatory descriptive robustness analyses.
status: NEW PAPER3 DECISION / HUMAN APPROVED AND FROZEN

recommended_option: Use six Ribo-seq columns with condition levels Control for GSM3900208-210 and Knockdown for GSM3900211-213; retain exact reagent only as provenance/robustness metadata.
alternative_options: Use a reagent predictor or an assay-by-condition design.
scientific_rationale: This is the mechanical encoding of the human-approved pooled-arm scientific choice in the exact six-library metadata.
inferential_consequence: Implements the primary contrast Knockdown minus Control without pre-model count pooling.
reviewer_risk_consequence: The packaged Paper 1 2x2 backend cannot be used unchanged; adapter validation is required before execution.
status: DETERMINISTIC ADAPTATION / FROZEN

recommended_option: Keep RNA-seq orthogonal and secondary; exclude it from response, offset, design, dispersion, and contrast of the local TMD Ribo-seq model.
alternative_options: RNA covariate/offset; joint assay interaction; title-index pairing.
scientific_rationale: Assays measure different modalities, no biological-pair identifier is frozen, and the local model already has a Ribo target/background exposure.
inferential_consequence: Primary coefficient is local Ribo occupancy, not translational efficiency.
reviewer_risk_consequence: Reviewers may request a separate RNA analysis; ad hoc RNA adjustment would redefine the question.
status: NEW PAPER3 DECISION / HUMAN APPROVED AND FROZEN

recommended_option: Define beta_condition as the exposure-adjusted log2 target-count rate ratio Knockdown over Control at +75; positive values mean greater local occupancy in Knockdown.
alternative_options: Reverse sign; reagent-specific estimands; RNA-adjusted translational efficiency.
scientific_rationale: An explicit sign and scale prevent ambiguous reporting and align with the pooled-arm question.
inferential_consequence: Sets the coefficient, null beta=0, QL test, and biological interpretation.
reviewer_risk_consequence: Mislabeling the sign or implying reagent specificity would be a major review issue.
status: NEW PAPER3 DECISION / HUMAN APPROVED AND FROZEN

recommended_option: Start from exactly 15,597 frozen primary-window-valid real TMD anchors, then apply inherited sample-dependent coverage/all-zero rules.
alternative_options: Use all 19,784 anchors; restrict to 9,829 pseudo pairs; restrict to 13,060 coordinate-null-v2 anchors.
scientific_rationale: 15,597 is the mechanically valid real-anchor universe for the primary +75 window; control subsets answer different questions.
inferential_consequence: Primary inferential rows are the coverage-eligible, non-all-zero subset of these anchors.
reviewer_risk_consequence: Substituting a control subset would change generalizability and invite selection-bias concerns.
status: DETERMINISTIC ADAPTATION / FROZEN

recommended_option: Use target [+60,+91), target length 31, integer target count, and offset log((background_count+0.5)*31/background_length).
alternative_options: Different target width/center; descriptive ratio as model response.
scientific_rationale: The clean release fully recovers these executable rules.
inferential_consequence: Preserves Paper 1's exposure-adjusted target-count estimand.
reviewer_risk_consequence: Changing geometry or modeling a derived ratio would be a post-provenance method change.
status: INHERITED / FROZEN

recommended_option: Require background_count >= 20 in every one of the six model libraries; strict intersection; invalid is missing; exclude all-zero target rows from inference.
alternative_options: Per-condition or union eligibility; clipping; zero filling.
scientific_rationale: This is the clean-release coverage contract and prevents sample-composition changes by condition.
inferential_consequence: Defines a common inferential anchor set and protects offset validity.
reviewer_risk_consequence: Strict intersection can reduce power but is more defensible than outcome-dependent sample eligibility.
status: INHERITED / FROZEN

recommended_option: Exclude every frozen DeepTMHMM TMhelix, signal, and Beta sheet interval from the ordinary translated-CDS background using the inherited [A-30,max(E,A+136)) geometry, then remove the tested target.
alternative_options: TMhelix only; TMhelix plus signal; label-specific geometries.
scientific_rationale: The primary TMD universe remains alpha-helical TMhelix only, while defining background as non-topology translated CDS prevents signal-peptide and beta-barrel membrane regions from contaminating the reference background.
inferential_consequence: Changes background counts/lengths but does not redefine signal or Beta sheet as primary TMDs and does not change the primary target definition.
reviewer_risk_consequence: Broader masking may reduce coverage, but the topology classes and exclusion geometry are fixed before biological outcomes.
status: NEW PAPER3 DECISION / HUMAN APPROVED AND FROZEN

recommended_option: Use edgeR negative-binomial QL with estimateDisp robust=TRUE, glmQLFit robust=TRUE, separate library columns, QL F-test, BH, and FDR < 0.05.
alternative_options: Wald/LRT model; non-robust dispersion; count pooling.
scientific_rationale: This is the executable Paper 1 model family.
inferential_consequence: Retains empirical-Bayes dispersion borrowing and robust QL inference.
reviewer_risk_consequence: The exact Paper 1 2x2 wrapper is incompatible and must be adapted, not run unchanged.
status: INHERITED / FROZEN

recommended_option: Use design ~ condition with Control as reference and test the Knockdown coefficient.
alternative_options: No-intercept two-column design; reagent terms; Paper 1 2x2 interaction.
scientific_rationale: Once the pooled-arm estimand is chosen, this is its direct full-rank encoding.
inferential_consequence: Produces the requested Knockdown-minus-Control coefficient.
reviewer_risk_consequence: Design coding and contrast sign require explicit adapter tests.
status: DETERMINISTIC ADAPTATION / FROZEN

recommended_option: Apply BH at alpha 0.05 across all inferential real anchors at the predeclared +75 center for the single primary contrast.
alternative_options: Genome-wide unadjusted tests; combine positional centers with the primary family.
scientific_rationale: Matches the clean-release primary-family logic.
inferential_consequence: Controls FDR for the primary per-anchor discovery family.
reviewer_risk_consequence: Eligibility must be fixed without inspecting effects.
status: INHERITED / FROZEN

recommended_option: Keep +75 as the primary BH family; make the ten non-primary center-wise BH families and one complete anchor-by-center BH family mandatory predeclared secondary analyses, all at FDR 0.05.
alternative_options: One joint spline; choose the best center; omit the complete anchor-by-center family.
scientific_rationale: Mechanically maps the inherited independent-center and complete-grid Paper 1 multiplicity structure to the frozen 11-center grid.
inferential_consequence: All positional secondary families are mandatory and cannot redefine the +75 primary center; any other family is outside the contract.
reviewer_risk_consequence: Selection of a favorable center would inflate error; mandatory global BH provides the inherited conservative sensitivity.
status: DETERMINISTIC ADAPTATION / FROZEN

recommended_option: Keep each anchor as a separate primary response row with no gene/transcript cluster term; require gene-level influence diagnostics for global controls.
alternative_options: Collapse anchors by gene; cluster-aware primary model.
scientific_rationale: This preserves the Paper 1 primary unit and avoids changing the target from anchors to genes.
inferential_consequence: Primary per-anchor FDR does not model within-gene dependence explicitly.
reviewer_risk_consequence: Reviewers may question correlated anchors; gene LOO is an influence check, not formal dependence correction.
status: INHERITED / FROZEN

recommended_option: Treat the length-matched pseudo segment as a virtual focal segment for background geometry only; with A=pseudo-segment start/pseudo anchor and E=pseudo-segment end, apply the full inherited [A-30,max(E,A+136)) exclusion, retain the P3-08 real-topology masks, then remove the 31-nt pseudo target.
alternative_options: No pseudo focal-neighborhood exclusion; focal-segment-only exclusion; local-flank background.
scientific_rationale: The full inherited focal geometry preserves real/pseudo background-exposure symmetry because the pseudo segment is length-matched to its real TMD partner.
inferential_consequence: Pseudo beta and delta use background exposure constructed by the same focal rule as the paired real TMD.
reviewer_risk_consequence: The pseudo segment is a geometric control only and must never be interpreted or labeled as a predicted TMD.
status: NEW PAPER3 DECISION / HUMAN APPROVED AND FROZEN

recommended_option: A pair is inferentially eligible only if real and pseudo independently pass identical frozen six-library structural, background>=20, strict-intersection, and model-estimability requirements; compute delta_i=beta_real_i-beta_pseudo_i, average eligible deltas within transcript to D_t, and use transcript D_t as equal-weight inferential units in one one-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test with alternative greater; PASS requires median(D_t)>0 and P<0.05; pair deltas are descriptive only.
alternative_options: Joint real/pseudo-by-condition model with transcript-clustered sandwich inference; transcript bootstrap; transcript-level sign test.
scientific_rationale: Transcript aggregation removes anchor pseudoreplication while preserving matching and a transparent effect definition.
inferential_consequence: One global transcript-level validation P value; no pair-level significance claims.
reviewer_risk_consequence: Averaging loses within-transcript heterogeneity and signed-rank symmetry may be challenged; mandatory cluster LOO supplies the frozen influence gate.
status: NEW PAPER3 DECISION / HUMAN APPROVED AND FROZEN

recommended_option: For coordinate-null v2 downstream statistics only, apply anchor-relative null exclusion [q-30,q+136), retain frozen real-topology masks, and remove the null 31-nt target; do not alter coordinates, candidate pools, RNG, seed, realization matrices, or the v2 universe.
alternative_options: Keep point-null target removal only and accept asymmetry; redesign/regenerate null coordinates.
scientific_rationale: A symmetric background makes real/null density differences attributable to position rather than unequal focal masking and does not require TMD length.
inferential_consequence: Changes downstream null background algebra only; v2 coordinates and production artifacts remain immutable.
reviewer_risk_consequence: The point-null analogue must not be described as a synthetic TMD segment.
status: NEW PAPER3 DECISION / HUMAN APPROVED AND FROZEN

recommended_option: On the authoritative v2 universe of 13,060 anchors in 3,997 transcripts, compute the equal-library mean log2 pseudocount-stabilized target/background density ratio at +75 for real coordinates and each of 10,000 frozen v2 realizations; use right-tailed p=(count(S_null>=S_real)+1)/10001; PASS requires S_real>median(S_null) and p<0.05; this is localization, not a condition effect.
alternative_options: Arithmetic mean raw ratio; median log2 ratio; transcript-weighted mean log2 ratio; 11-center maximum; condition-effect null.
scientific_rationale: Log transformation compresses extreme ratios, treats reciprocal changes symmetrically, and aligns with the Paper 3 log2 framework.
inferential_consequence: Tests real-coordinate localization and yields one global empirical P value; it does not test Knockdown versus Control.
reviewer_risk_consequence: Mean log ratios imply a geometric-mean interpretation and remain conditional on the frozen v2 generator and universe.
status: NEW PAPER3 DECISION / HUMAN APPROVED AND FROZEN

recommended_option: Retain separate one-sided alpha 0.05 transcript-level real-pseudo and coordinate-null tests as necessary intersection components; neither is sufficient alone and neither changes primary per-anchor BH.
alternative_options: BH across two tests; omnibus combined P value; either-test-sufficient rule.
scientific_rationale: The controls assess distinct necessary properties and the benchmark claim requires their intersection with the other frozen gate components.
inferential_consequence: No validation P value changes primary per-anchor BH; both core controls must pass the benchmark gate.
reviewer_risk_consequence: Separate alpha levels must be described as necessary intersection criteria rather than alternative discoveries.
status: NEW PAPER3 DECISION / HUMAN APPROVED AND FROZEN

recommended_option: Refit after omitting Treatment_A (siP1_1), then after omitting Treatment_B (siP2_1 and siP2_4); recompute eligibility; report directions, median effect, Spearman correlation, and sign concordance without reagent-specific P/FDR; if the core gate passes but either omission reverses the full-model median real-anchor beta sign, assign PASS WITH CAUTION.
alternative_options: Unreplicated reagent contrasts; reagent fixed effect; no omission check.
scientific_rationale: The refits diagnose dominance by a reagent class without pretending exact-reagent replication.
inferential_consequence: Both are descriptive; the Treatment_B omission has one treated library and cannot support population inference.
reviewer_risk_consequence: Single-library instability is likely and must be labeled rather than overinterpreted.
status: NEW PAPER3 DECISION / HUMAN APPROVED AND FROZEN

recommended_option: Omit one anchor and matched pseudo/null record; recompute aggregate statistics and report maximal statistic/P changes and influential anchors; do not require every iteration to retain P<0.05.
alternative_options: Hard anchor-level all-iterations gate; omit anchor LOO.
scientific_rationale: Finds individually influential pairs without pretending that single-anchor removal addresses clustered multi-TMD dependence.
inferential_consequence: Descriptive influence diagnostic only; it cannot pass or fail the benchmark gate.
reviewer_risk_consequence: A descriptive diagnostic may reveal nominal decision changes that still require discussion, but does not create an arbitrary hard failure.
status: NEW PAPER3 DECISION / HUMAN APPROVED AND FROZEN

recommended_option: Mandatory transcript LOO removes every anchor/control record in one transcript; mandatory gene LOO removes all records assigned to one gene using the authoritative one-to-one mapping covering 19,192/19,192 frozen transcripts; every cluster omission must retain positive direction and the corresponding P<0.05 core conclusion.
alternative_options: Anchor-only gate; transcript-only without gene grouping; cluster bootstrap.
scientific_rationale: Removing the entire biological cluster addresses correlated multi-TMD dependence directly.
inferential_consequence: Mandatory benchmark robustness gate; not a new P-value family or formal cluster-variance correction.
reviewer_risk_consequence: All-cluster retention is conservative; instability fails the benchmark gate.
status: NEW PAPER3 DECISION / HUMAN APPROVED AND FROZEN

recommended_option: PASS requires the intersection of real-pseudo core PASS, coordinate-null core PASS, LDB-1 PASS, NGS-1 equivalence PASS, and every mandatory transcript/gene LOO retaining positive direction and the corresponding <0.05 core conclusion; failure of any required component is FAIL; if all required components pass but reagent omission reverses direction, assign PASS WITH CAUTION; otherwise PASS; do not require a minimum number of primary discoveries.
alternative_options: Either-test-sufficient rule; omit qualitative criteria; choose after results; require primary discoveries.
scientific_rationale: The complete rule operationalizes every approved benchmark criterion before outcome inspection.
inferential_consequence: The benchmark qualifies method validity without altering primary per-anchor FDR; a null primary biological-result set remains permissible.
reviewer_risk_consequence: The intersection is stringent but avoids post-result gate selection.
status: NEW PAPER3 DECISION / HUMAN APPROVED AND FROZEN

recommended_option: Pin R 4.6.0 and edgeR 4.10.3; record full sessionInfo, paths, platform, library path, release hashes, and adapter provenance at freeze.
alternative_options: Validate and freeze a different current runtime.
scientific_rationale: The installed runtime exactly matches the audited Paper 1 run.
inferential_consequence: Minimizes software-version drift in the adapted model.
reviewer_risk_consequence: Compatibility of the new one-factor adapter still requires code tests; version identity alone is insufficient.
status: INHERITED / FROZEN

recommended_option: Freeze LDB-1 on common all-center eligibility I*: B={+60,+75,+90}, O=the other eight frozen centers, R_t(c)=mean eligible real-anchor beta within transcript, P_t=mean_B R_t(c), Q_t=mean_O R_t(c); PASS requires median(P_t)>0, median(P_t-Q_t)>0, and one-sided Wilcoxon P<0.05 for P_t-Q_t>0.
alternative_options: LDB-2 deterministic peak-location rule; LDB-3 three-center BH-positive band.
scientific_rationale: Directly tests concentration in the prespecified downstream band using transcript-level units and common all-center eligibility.
inferential_consequence: Mandatory benchmark component; it does not alter the primary estimand.
reviewer_risk_consequence: Averaging may hide heterogeneous profiles, but the band and rule are fixed before outcomes.
status: NEW PAPER3 DECISION / HUMAN APPROVED AND FROZEN

decision: Absence of global nonspecific shift criterion
recommended_option: Freeze NGS-1 using Q_t from LDB-1, epsilon=log2(1.20), and a 90% signed-rank/Hodges-Lehmann-compatible confidence interval for the transcript-level off-band location; PASS only when the complete interval lies strictly inside [-log2(1.20),+log2(1.20)].
alternative_options: NGS-2 no detectable off-band aggregate; NGS-3 no uniformly signed positional shift.
scientific_rationale: Equivalence provides affirmative evidence that the off-band aggregate is practically negligible within the predeclared ±20% margin.
inferential_consequence: Mandatory benchmark component; it does not alter the primary estimand.
reviewer_risk_consequence: The margin is a new scientific threshold but is human-approved before outcomes; the signed-rank interval assumes an appropriate transcript-level location interpretation.
status: NEW PAPER3 DECISION / HUMAN APPROVED AND FROZEN
